slot.brief: A pointing puzzle ('he is the son of my grandfather's only son' style) with three-step chain; ask the exact relation of the speaker to the person pointed at.

stem: Mira, a woman, points to a man and says, “He is the son of the only daughter of my maternal grandmother.” How is Mira related to him?

verdicts.working: Mira’s maternal grandmother’s only daughter is Mira’s mother. The man is her mother’s son, so Mira is his sister.

working:
The only daughter of Mira’s maternal grandmother is Mira’s mother. The man is her mother’s son; since Mira is a woman, he is her brother. Mira is his sister.
